title: 二叉树中的最大路径和
statement:
二叉树中的一条路径是由若干节点组成的序列，相邻节点之间有边相连，且每个节点至多出现一次；路径至少包含一个节点，不必经过根。路径和为路径上所有节点值之和。给定二叉树的根节点 root，返回所有路径中的最大路径和。

节点定义：struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }。输入中的树为 LeetCode 层序表示，null 表示空位。

en.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
en.statement:
A path in a binary tree is a sequence of nodes where adjacent nodes are connected by an edge and each node appears at most once; a path contains at least one node and need not pass through the root. The path sum is the sum of the node values on the path. Given the root of a binary tree, return the maximum path sum over all paths.

Node definition: struct TreeNode { int val; TreeNode *left; TreeNode *right; }. The input tree uses LeetCode level-order representation, with null marking empty positions.
constraints: The number of nodes is in the range [1, 3·10^4]; -1000 ≤ Node.val ≤ 1000

complexity.space: O(h) recursion stack (or explicit stack for iterative postorder), worst case O(n).
complexity.notes: n is the number of nodes and h is the tree height. In a postorder traversal compute each node's best downward single-branch contribution max(0, left, right) + val, and update the answer with val + max(0,left) + max(0,right). The answer's absolute value is at most 3·10^7, so int suffices. The largest local test is a 3·10^4-node single chain (recursion depth 3·10^4, fine with the default stack), plus an all-negative tree and a random 10^4-node tree.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is m (the number of level-order tokens); line 2 has m tokens (integers or null), the tree's LeetCode level-order representation. stdout: one integer, the maximum path sum.

complexity.space: O(h) 递归栈（或迭代后序的显式栈），最坏 O(n)。
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为节点数，h 为树高。后序遍历求每个节点向下的最大单链贡献 max(0, 左, 右) + val，并用 val + max(0,左) + max(0,右) 更新答案。答案绝对值不超过 3·10^7，int 足够。本地最大测试为 3·10^4 个节点的单链（递归深度 3·10^4，默认栈可承受），另含全负树与 10^4 个节点的随机树。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 m（层序 token 数）；第二行 m 个 token（整数或 null），为树的 LeetCode 层序表示。stdout：一个整数，最大路径和。
